title: Win-Win Negotiation Skills
overview: Negotiation is an integral aspect of our daily interactions. Whether with customers, suppliers, colleagues, business associates, or family members, we engage in negotiations regularly. Essentially, negotiation is the process through which individuals resolve differences and strive to achieve their desired outcomes from others. Unfortunately, business negotiations often focus solely on price, neglecting the potential for maximizing overall value in a partnership. This negotiation training course aims to provide insights into the behaviors of effective negotiators while helping you develop your negotiation skills. Through a series of group exercises, you'll have the opportunity to learn and apply proven negotiation tactics, refine your personal negotiating style, and enhance your proficiency in negotiating successfully.
audience: This course is tailored for executives, managers, professionals, salespeople, entrepreneurs, customer service representatives, and individuals aiming to improve their negotiation skills. The objective is to make negotiations a more enjoyable, rewarding, and effective component of their job responsibilities
methodology: In this course, participants will engage in a blend of interactive and collaborative learning methods, including lectures, presentations, interactive exercises, games, group activities, and role plays.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Compare and contrast the Integrative and Distributive types of negotiations
Evaluate and assess the Soft, Hard, and Principled styles in negotiation
Identify and assess personality styles in negotiation
Distinguish between the four phases of negotiation
Examine and apply different negotiating tactics
Discover the optimal approach to resolving conflicts and building trust
Plan and execute effective negotiations as part of a negotiating team
